entries.claim: Global oil and gas shipping costs surge as Iran closes Strait of Hormuz
entries.article_title: Global oil and gas shipping costs surge as Iran closes Strait of Hormuz
aliases: Global oil and gas shipping costs surge as Iran closes Strait of Hormuz
Global oil and gas shipping costs surge as Iran closes Strait of Hormuz
entries.assessment: The Reuters graphics can illustrate disrupted traffic or shipping costs if their plotted labels are legible. The images alone do not establish that Iran fully closed the Strait or caused every cost increase.

entries.claim: Watch shipping through the Strait of Hormuz grind to a halt
entries.article_title: Watch shipping through the Strait of Hormuz grind to a halt amid Iran conflict
aliases: Watch shipping through the Strait of Hormuz grind to a halt
Watch shipping through the Strait of Hormuz grind to a halt amid Iran conflict
entries.assessment: Traffic imagery can show reduced vessel movement at a particular time. It cannot by itself establish a complete halt across the Strait.

entries.claim: Three Iranian tankers leave the Strait carrying 5 million barrels

aliases: Three Iranian tankers leave the Strait carrying 5 million barrels
3 tankers of the Iranian state-owned shipping company leave the Strait of Hormuz with 5 million barrels of oil
entries.assessment: A vessel picture cannot establish that three specific Iranian tankers carried five million barrels. The archived article record also contains a March 30 update despite a March 4 stored date.

entries.claim: U.S. will insure and escort tankers: Trump

aliases: U.S. will insure and escort tankers: Trump
U.S. will insure and escort oil tankers in Strait of Hormuz during Iran conflict: Trump
entries.assessment: A photograph of Trump or a ship does not establish that insurance or escorts were implemented; the statement itself needs an original text or recording.

entries.claim: Iran attacked a tanker near the Strait

entries.claim: Iran closes Strait, oil prices surge, and other developments

entries.claim: Oil prices heading for largest weekly gains since 2020

aliases: Oil prices heading for largest weekly gains since 2020
Oil prices are heading for their largest weekly gains since 2020 with the cessation of shipping through the Strait of Hormuz
entries.assessment: A dated oil-price chart can support the direction and size of a price change; a fuel-station or tanker photo is only market context.

entries.claim: Trump announces shipping solution for Hormuz

aliases: Trump announces shipping solution for Hormuz
Trump announced a solution to the problem of shipping through the Strait of Hormuz
entries.assessment: A naval vessel photograph shows military presence, not that an escort program began. An announcement requires source text or audio.

aliases: Iranian drones attack a ship in Hormuz

entries.claim: Hormuz crisis strengthens Indo-Pacific–Middle East ties

aliases: Hormuz crisis strengthens Indo-Pacific–Middle East ties
The Strait of Hormuz crisis has strengthened strategic ties between the Indo-Pacific and the Middle East
entries.assessment: An energy-dependence map can illustrate why the Indo-Pacific may be exposed to Hormuz disruption, but it does not prove new strategic ties were formed.

entries.claim: Same regional analysis in Traditional Chinese

aliases: Same regional analysis in Traditional Chinese
The Strait of Hormuz crisis brought the Indo-Pacific closer to the Central and Eastern War strategy
entries.assessment: The map and satellite views supply geographic or import-dependence context. A historical graphic does not establish March 2026 policy changes.

aliases: Baghaei says Hormuz is unsafe
